|title=Mojo's 17th Birthday Celebration |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/post/684717 |access-date=7 January 2026 |work=Daily Sun |language=en}}{{Cite news |date=2024-03-12 |title=Mojo's Gaza aid also rockets its sales |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/economy/mojos-gaza-aid-also-rockets-its-sales-807686 |access-date=2024-06-25 |work=[[The Business Standard]] |language=en}} The soft drink brand Mojo has |access-date=7 January 2026 |work=[[The Daily Ittefaq]] |date=1 January 2025 |language=bn}}{{cite news |title=Bangladesh Brand Forum awards most loved brands of Bangladesh |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/amp/business/399281/bangladesh-brand-forum-awards-most-loved-brands-of |access-date=7 January 2026 |work=[[Dhaka Tribune]] |date=21 December 2025 |language=en}} == History == The brand was launched in April 2006 by [[Akij Group]]'s sister project Akij Food & Beverage Limited (AFBL).{{cite news |url=https://www.banglatribune.com/press-release/794455/%E0%A6%AE%E0%A7%8B%E0%A6%9C%E0%A7%8B%E2%80%99%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A7%A7%E0%A7%AD%E0%A6%A4%E0%A6%AE-%E0%A6%9C%E0%A6%A8%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%AE%E0%A6%A6%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%A8-%E0%A6%89%E0%A6%A6%E0%A6%AF%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%A8 |script-title=bn:মোজো'র ১৭তম জন্মদিন উদযাপন |date=14 April 2023 |access-date=11 October 2024 |work=[[Bangla Tribune]] |language=bn}} Mojo manufactures and distributes both domestically and abroad. Mojo has exported to 47 countries around the world.{{Cite web |title=AKij Food & Beverage |url=https://www.akijfood.com/ |access-date=2024-06-25 |website=akijfood.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Akij Venture Ltd |url=https://www.akijventure.com/www.akijventure.com |access-date=2024-06-25 |website=akijventure.com}} After the [[Gaza war]], many Muslims in [[Bangladesh]] began boycotting the products of various companies, including [[Coca-Cola]], due to its affiliations with Israel, in which Coca-Cola's sale was decreased by 60%. During the same period, Mojo run a donation campaign where every ৳1 [[Bangladeshi taka|BDT]] (approximately US$0.0081) would go to the [[Palestine]] donation fund.{{cite news |last1=Halder |first1=Sukanta |title=Mojo raised Tk 4.14cr aid for the Palestinians |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/mojo-raised-tk-414cr-aid-the-palestinians-3869661 |access-date=7 January 2026 |work=The Daily Star |date=12 April 2025 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Mahmud |first1=Faisal |title=Coca-Cola ad in Bangladesh sparks backlash for 'denying ties with Israel' |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2024/6/12/coca-cola-ad-in-bangladesh-sparks-backlash-for-denying-ties-with-israel |access-date=7 January 2026 |publisher=[[Al Jazeera]] |language=en}} This campaign led to the significant rise in sales recording the highest sale in the brand's history. The significant rise in demand leads to them facing product shortages.{{Cite news |date=2024-06-12 |script-title=bn:গাজা যুদ্ধকে কেন্দ্র করে বাংলাদেশে কোমল পানীয়র বাজারে যে 'কোল্ড ওয়ার' চলছে |url=https://www.bbc.com/bengali/articles/cmll887xge3o |access-date=2024-07-11 |work=[[BBC Bangla]] |language=bn}}{{cite news |title=10 Mojo volunteers 'killed' in Israeli strike while delivering aid in Gaza |url=https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/4e4a9e53ac01 |access-date=7 January 2026 |work=bdnews24.com |language=en}} On 2 January 2024, Sheikh Shamim Uddin, chairman of [[Akij Group]], presented a cheque of 50 lac [[taka]] or US$41,821 to the [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] ambassador.{{Cite news |work=bdnews24.com |script-title=bn:ফিলিস্তিনিদের অর্থ সহায়তা দিল 'মোজো' |url=https://bangla.bdnews24.com/business/9ve6zpa6gf |access-date=2024-06-25 |language=bn}} Through the [[World Food Programme]] (WFP), Akij Welfare Trust and Mojo have donated Tk 61,750,000 or US$516,493 to [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and Tk 15,000,000 to Palestine Embassy as of June 2024.{{cite news |title=How Coke boycott helped Mojo donate 1.5C to Palestine |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/amp/business/338367/how-coke-boycott-helped-mojo-donate-tk1.5c-to |access-date=7 January 2026 |work=[[Dhaka Tribune]] |date=1 February 2024 |language=en}} == Other extract: Mojo is a cola flavored carbonated soft drink manufactured by the Akij Food and Beverage Limited (AFBL). The soft drink brand Mojo has been recognized by Bangladesh Brand Forum as the "number one beverage brand in Bangladesh" in the "Best Brand Award 2024".
